info.title: ARD Eventhub
info.description: ARD system to distribute real-time (live) metadata for primarily radio broadcasts.

post.summary: Swap login credentials for a token
Swap refresh token for new id token

requestBody.description:
New event to be distributed to subscribers.

The Eventhub format validation expects only a subset of these variables as minimum set. All other fields are technically optional, but **highly encouraged** to be included, so a best-possible metadata exchange is possible.

The subset is defined in the list of required fields of Schemas `eventV1PostBody`, resulting in this body:

```json
{
  "type": "music",
  "start": "2020-01-19T06:00:00+01:00",
  "title": "Song name",
  "services": [ { ... } ],
  "playlistItemId": "swr3-5678"
}
```

Required fields not specified in the Schema, will cause your request to fail.

The `id` is inserted by Eventhub as string-formatted number, but might be a true string in the future, do not expect this string to remain numbers only!

201.description:
Event created

*Note:* The first request of an event for an externalId that is not registered yet, will return the status `failed: 1`. This indicates that a new topic for the externalId has been created, and the request needs to be repeated:

```json
"statuses": {
  "published": 0,
  "blocked": 0,
  "failed": 1
}
```

If the request returns the status `blocked: 1`, it indicates that you are not allowed to publish events under the given publisherId.

publisherId.description: External ID or globally unique identifier (Core ID) for the associated publisher. When no Core ID is provided, the External ID will be converted by Eventhub.

id.description: Globally unique identifier, created by Eventhub

event.description: If set, it needs to match the URL event parameter

type.description: The type of the element that triggered this event. See additional file in docs for details.

length.description: Estimated length of the element in seconds. Must be set to a positive number (not 0 or null). The end of the current element is defined by the start of the next element.

contributors.description: Full details about involved artists if available

services.description: The playing stations unique Service-IDs. Do not include the Service-Type suffix.

playlistItemId.description: Unique identifier (within a publisher) to connect next and playing items if needed

hfdbIds.description: Can reference all available tracks in ARD HFDB instances. Should ideally at least include the common ZSK instance.

externalId.description: Can reference the original ID in the publisher's system

isrc.description: Appropriate ISRC code if track is a music element

upc.description: Corresponding reference to an album where such ISRC was published

mpn.description: If available the reference to the original delivery from MPN

media.description: Can contain an array of media files like cover, artist, etc.

plugins.description: Highly optional field for future third-party metadata distribution or other connected services

id.description: ID gets inserted by Eventhub as string-formatted number, but might be a true string in the future, do not expect this string to remain numbers only!

eventV1PostBody.description: **Please also note the details in the `POST /events/v1` endpoint above!**
